claim: Another study describes the WPSH, Typhoons In-Fa and Cempaka, and a Eurasian trough–ridge structure as contributing to the favorable circulation and moisture conditions; it also points to low-level convergence, upper-level divergence, and topographic blocking and lifting near Zhengzhou.
reason: S3 mentions WPSH, In-Fa and Cempaka, Eurasian trough-ridge structure, favorable circulation and water vapor, low-level convergence, high-level dispersion, and topographic blocking near Zhengzhou. 'Upper-level divergence' is paraphrase of high-level dispersion; all points are covered.
